inputs.subject: Redecorating my daughter's room — colors chosen & $900 budget
inputs.body:
Hi Alara,

I hope you’re well. I’m redecorating my 10-year-old daughter’s bedroom (she loves unicorns) and I’d like your help implementing the plan. We’ve decided on the following color scheme and a fixed budget:

- Walls: pale lavender (soft lilac)
- Curtains: blush pink (sheer)
- Bed: crisp white
- Pillows: pastel mint green

Budget: $900 USD (total for paint, curtains, bedding, any small furnishings and labor you recommend).

Could you please review these choices and let me know if you can take this on? I would appreciate a brief proposal that includes:
- A rough cost breakdown (paint, materials, sourcing items, labor) that fits within the $900 budget
- Recommended paint finish (e.g., eggshell, satin) and any tips for durability/cleanability for a child’s room
- Suggestions for where to source the curtains, bedding, and removable unicorn-themed accents (stickers, wall decals, throw pillows) within the budget
- An estimated timeline and your availability for an initial consultation

If you need any measurements or photos of the room before preparing a proposal, I can send them right away. Looking forward to working with you on this — thanks!

Best,
[Your Name]
